LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words do we use when making a choice between two things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text
2. use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication
3. use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTIONS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions for Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words do we use when making a choice between two things?
